title: CP: Add term-plugin scope (plugins/term/**)
body: Scope policy: PLAN-31 required edits under plugins/term/**. Propose adding a dedicated scope entry  to .clinerules/scope.json with paths: ["plugins/term/**","nexoscli-bin/tests/**","docs/**"]. Rationale: future term observability work (fs topic evolution) needs bounded scope without broadening observability. Acceptance: scope entry merged; rules doc updated.
